dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible across the dorsal region are multiple closed elliptical and open 'C' shaped structures. The most prominent three exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a 2-4 pixel wide dark perimeter to a high-luminance interior core. These geometries are primarily concentrated in the anterior and mid-dorsal sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high-density cluster of high-intensity white pixels is concentrated on the lower-mid lateral flank. This region contains a core concentration of irregular, fused blobs with high pixel values that lack internal textural gradients, creating a localized patch of maximum luminance.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An irregular polygon is formed by the spatial relationships between the centroids of the two largest dorsal-anterior annuli, the primary central-dorsal ring, and the geometric center of the high-intensity lateral cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast speckled region on the lower-mid lateral surface contrasts sharply with the lower-frequency, ring-based texture found on the dorsal surface.
